summary: Baileys fork with weak static match on generics.js
details: Package is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web library. A a static rule fired on lib/Utils/generics.js citing keyword co-occurrence ("ping", "GET", "id") — shapes that are ubiquitous in a WhatsApp protocol client (WebSocket keepalive pings, HTTP GET media downloads, message id fields) and are not by themselves evidence of exfiltration. No specific installer-side secret read, no hardcoded attacker destination, and no install/import-time execution of attacker-controlled code is identifiable from the cited evidence. Being a fork of a widely-copied library, the code base has known patterns that trigger keyword-based scanners without indicating malicious intent in this version.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
